universe.description: DESI 2024 paper fiducial configuration for LRG1 + LRG2 reproduction.

analysis.name: DESI DR1 BAO Analysis
analysis.description: Reproduction of the DESI DR1 configuration-space BAO measurement across eight tracer-redshift bins, from density-field reconstruction and clustering through BAO fitting to cosmological distance constraints.

before (`Pre`) and after (`Post`) reconstruction. Each row gives the
posterior mean and dispersion of the isotropic dilation
$\alpha_\mathrm{iso}$ (`qiso`, `alpha1_*`) and — for the 2D fits —

modelling-systematic budget, with the statistical-only error kept in

Each panel shows $s^2\,\Delta\xi_\ell(s)$ — the measured multipole

BAO detection significance per tracer. $\Delta\chi^2$ between a
no-BAO (broadband-only) reference and the damped-BAO template, as a
function of the isotropic dilation $\alpha_\mathrm{iso}$, for each
post-reconstruction correlation function. A well-defined minimum
near $\alpha_\mathrm{iso} = 1$ signals a detection of the acoustic
feature at the expected scale, and the depth of the minimum sets
the per-tracer detection significance quoted in the legend.

Final DESI DR1 BAO distance constraints, per tracer at its
effective redshift $z_\mathrm{eff}$: the comoving transverse
distance $D_M/r_d$, the Hubble distance $D_H/r_d$, the
angle-averaged distance $D_V/r_d$, and the ratio $D_M/D_H$, all
relative to the sound horizon at the drag epoch $r_d$. Values are
derived from the post-reconstruction chains, with the combined
modelling + HOD + fiducial-cosmology systematic budget folded into
the quoted uncertainties (`_std` columns); `r_off` is the
$D_M$–$D_H$ posterior correlation. The 1D-fit tracers (BGS, ELG1,
QSO) constrain only $D_V/r_d$, so their $D_M$ and $D_H$ entries
are empty.

Corner plot of post-recon BAO distance posteriors with α residuals
from fiducial Planck 2018-ΛCDM in a top inset.

The DESI DR1 BAO distances on the Hubble diagram. From top to
bottom: $D_M/r_d$, $D_H/r_d$, $D_V/r_d$, and $D_M/D_H$ as a
function of redshift, each divided by the prediction of the DESI
fiducial cosmology (Planck 2018 $\Lambda$CDM), so the line at
unity is the fiducial model. Coloured points are the DESI DR1
tracers measured in this analysis; grey symbols are earlier
measurements from 6dFGS, WiggleZ, SDSS DR16, and DES Y6.

decisions.label: Covariance matrix source
decisions.rationale:
The ξ covariance for every BAO fit comes from RascalC
(semi-analytic 4-point integral + jackknife shot-noise rescaling).
RascalC is calibrated against the DESI fiducial reconstruction +
clustering pipeline: IterativeFFT RecSym, Σ_sm=15, lin4 s-binning,
WEIGHT*WEIGHT_FKP weights, and the specific random density used in
the published runs. Choosing the published VAC cov therefore locks
downstream recon + clustering decisions to the fiducial options;
the `self_computed` alternative was considered
(misharash/RascalC-scripts + Misha's RascalC C++ fork on NERSC)
but is excluded as out of scope for this reproduction -- see
`excluded_reason`.

options.label: DESI DR1 published RascalC-rescaled (fiducial)
options.description:
Ingested from /global/cfs/cdirs/desi/users/mrash/RascalC/Y1/
unblinded/v1.2/. One cov per tracer × pre/post state.

options.label: Rerun RascalC from scratch
options.description:
Full RascalC pipeline (pair counting + 4-point integration +
jackknife rescaling) against DR1 catalogs, per
misharash/RascalC-scripts.
options.excluded_reason:
~20 node-days of compute across all tracers × pre/post, plus
a private `desi_y1_files` (cosmodesi/desi-y1-kp) dependency
for filename resolution, and a version-drift issue (scripts
target v1.5, published cov is v1.2). Not in scope for this
reproduction. Choosing this option would also require
unlocking non-fiducial recon + clustering decisions (not
currently exposed as options).

decisions.label: Reconstruction Gaussian smoothing scale (BGS/LRG/ELG)
decisions.rationale:
Smoothing scale Sigma_sm applied to the density field before solving
for the displacement, for the BGS / LRG / ELG parents.
The BAO model's damping correction uses the same value, so recon and
fit must agree -- that's why this lives at the root and recon inherits
it. QSO has a distinct fiducial (sm30 vs sm15 here) and is
parameterized separately via `smoothing_radius_qso`.

decisions.label: Reconstruction Gaussian smoothing scale (QSO only)
decisions.rationale:
QSO's fiducial reconstruction smoothing is 30 h⁻¹ Mpc (vs 15 h⁻¹ Mpc
for BGS/LRG/ELG), reflecting the QSO sample's lower number density
and larger coherence scale. The BAO model's damping template must
match, so both the recon script and the fit scripts branch on
`tracer.id == "qso"` to consume this decision rather than
`smoothing_radius`. sm20 is the sensitivity-test alternative for QSO.

decisions.label: Broadband model
decisions.rationale:
Spline-based broadband (fiducial) vs polynomial-based (legacy form).
They give consistent BAO scales; the small difference goes into the
systematic error budget.

decisions.label: BAO damping parameter prior
decisions.rationale:
Gaussian priors on Σ_perp, Σ_par, Σ_s centered at fiducial values.
Gaussian is more robust than flat priors, but results are consistent
either way.

options.label: Flat
options.description: Uniform priors U[0, 20] for each damping parameter.

decisions.label: Fit range in s
decisions.rationale:
Fiducial is s ∈ [48, 152] Mpc/h at 4 Mpc/h binning.
Extend/narrow as sensitivity tests.

decisions.label: Multipoles fit (LRG only; 1D tracers override)
decisions.rationale:
LRG bins are fit with 2D (ℓ=0, 2). ELG1 / QSO are 1D-only regardless
of this setting -- the tracer's `ells` in `scripts/tracers.py` caps
the universe choice via an intersection in
`bao_utils.resolve_settings`, so `twod` means "2D where supported".

decisions.label: Damping prior central values
decisions.rationale:
Fiducial Σ_perp, Σ_par, Σ_s per tracer × recon state.
The per-tracer centers live in `scripts/tracers.py`; this decision is the
multiplicative scaling applied to them. Variants widen / narrow the
centers as a systematic test.

options.label: Fiducial (per tracer)
options.description: Unscaled fiducial centers for the tracer being fit.

decisions.label: BAO fit method
decisions.rationale:
Fiducial reports posterior-based intervals for the combined-tracer
rows and headline cosmological parameters — those come from emcee
chains. Profiling (Minuit) gives a faster point estimate +
parabolic errors, useful as a pipeline sanity check but not the
fiducial for reported alphas.

options.label: Sampling (emcee MCMC, fiducial)
options.description: Full posterior via emcee; burn-in + thin; matches DESI Y1v1 chains.

options.label: Profiling (Minuit)
options.description: MLE + Hessian intervals; fast sanity check.

decisions.label: BAO template cosmology
decisions.rationale:
AbacusSummit cosmologies used to test fiducial-cosmology systematics.
c000 is Planck-2018 ΛCDM (fiducial).

decisions.label: FoG damping placement
decisions.rationale:
Σ_s multiplies the smooth (no-wiggle) component only; the legacy
approach applied it to the full template, which introduces a
degeneracy with the BAO damping. "smooth_only" is the fiducial,
built into desilike's DampedBAOWigglesTracer... model;
the "full_model" alternative is declared but not wired
(would need a custom theory wrapper).

options.label: Smooth-only (fiducial)
options.description: Σ_s multiplies P_nw only; desilike default.

options.label: Full-model (legacy)
options.description: Σ_s multiplies wiggle + smooth; not wired, raises NotImplementedError.

decisions.label: Wiggle / no-wiggle split
decisions.rationale:
Fiducial uses the peak-average method of Brieden, Gil-Marín & Verde
2022 to split P_linear into wiggle + smooth components.
Eisenstein-Hu 1998 and Savitzky-Golay log-space filters are the
historical alternatives. The systematic budget assigns < 0.02% α_iso
/ < 0.09% α_AP to this choice. Only the fiducial is wired.

decisions.label: Component that α dilates
decisions.rationale:
The α_iso / α_AP rescaling is applied to the wiggle component only;
the smooth P_nw is evaluated at observed coordinates without dilation.
Dilating the full template is the alternative; the systematic budget
assigns < 0.02% α_iso / < 0.09% α_AP to this choice. Only the
fiducial is wired.

options.label: Wiggle-only (fiducial)
options.description: α rescales P_w; P_nw at observed coords. desilike default.

options.label: Full-template
options.description: α rescales wiggle + smooth; not wired, raises NotImplementedError.

decisions.label: Reported error includes modelling systematic
decisions.rationale:
Combined modelling systematic (0.1% α_iso, 0.2% α_AP, conservatively
0.2% on α_⊥ / α_∥) added in quadrature to the reported σ. Consumed
only by make_alpha_table.py -- the MCMC chains themselves are
untouched, so both options can be produced from the same fits by
re-running the table step. The stat-only σ is always kept as a
companion column (`alpha{1,2}_std_stat`).

options.label: Statistical only
options.description: σ_reported = σ_stat; tests raw constraining power.

prior_insights.claim: Σ⊥ and Σ∥ follow Σ⊥ = Σ0·G, Σ∥ = Σ0·G·(1+f) where Σ0 = 12.4 h^-1 Mpc for σ8 = 0.9 at z=0, scaling linearly with σ8 and redshift via the growth function -- the theoretical prediction that anchors the Gaussian prior centres.

quote.exact: The rms radial displacements across (Σ⊥) and along the line of sight (Σk) at this separation follow Σ⊥ = Σ0G and Σk = Σ0G(1 + f), where Σ0 = 12.4h−1 Mpc for a cosmology with σ8 = 0.9 at the present-day, f = d(ln G)/d(ln a) ∼ Ω0.6m , and G is the growth function while G is normalized to be G = 0.758 at z = 0 such that G(z) = (1 + z)−1 at high z.

prior_insights.scope: Theoretical prediction of BAO damping scales

prior_insights.claim: Nonlinear erasure of the BAO is modelled as convolution with a Gaussian Lagrangian-displacement distribution, which Fourier-transforms to the multiplicative exp(-k²Σ²/2) damping form used in BAO template fits.

quote.exact: A broadened peak will have the same power spectrum multiplied with an additional damping envelope set by the Fourier transformation of the broadened peak shape. For example, if the peak in the correlation function is broadened with a Gaussian function due to the Silk damping effect (Σs) and Lagrangian displacement distribution (Σnl), then the convolution in configuration space with the Gaussian function is Fourier-transformed to a multiplicative exponential factor in Fourier space.
quote.prefix: the Fourier transformation of the peak takes the following form in the power spectrum:
quote.suffix: Pb(k)

prior_insights.claim: Because Lagrangian displacements are dominated by bulk flows, galaxy bias has only a small effect on Σ⊥/Σ∥: highly biased tracers increase Lagrangian variances only by small amounts. Supports tracer-common Σ priors with modest tracer-dependent offsets.

quote.exact: From Eisenstein et al. analyses.name: Reconstruction
analyses.description: Density-field reconstruction for the DESI DR1 parent samples, producing shifted galaxy and random catalogs with diagnostic displacement metrics.

inputs.description:
DESI DR1 iron v1.5 LSS clustering catalogs (data + 18 randoms per cap).
Used by reconstruction (raw catalogs) and clustering (pre-recon xi).
All tracers live here -- LRG_{NGC,SGC}_clustering.{dat,ran_i}.fits,
ELG_LOPnotqso_*, QSO_*.

Tabulated z -> r(z) for the DESI fiducial cosmology
(AbacusSummit c000, Planck 2018 LCDM, Omega_m=0.3153, h=0.6736).
Must be used for redshift -> distance conversion to match DESI's
pkrun.py / TabulatedDESI; otherwise window/covariance get inflated.

outputs.description:
Shifted galaxy + random catalogs after reconstruction, BGS parent sample
(z=0.1-0.4, BGS_BRIGHT-21.5). Same NPZ format as
post_recon_catalog_lrg_full. The BGS tracer uses the full parent range
(not sub-binned).
Mean |Psi| for BGS parent (Mpc/h).

Shifted galaxy + random catalogs after reconstruction, LRG parent sample
(z=0.4-1.1). NPZ with arrays: gal_pos, gal_pos_shift, gal_weights, gal_z,
ran_pos, ran_pos_shift, ran_weights, ran_z (NGC+SGC concatenated;
positions in Cartesian Mpc/h, DESI fiducial cosmology). Downstream xi
computation slices by tracer z-range using gal_z / ran_z.
Mean |Psi| for LRG parent (Mpc/h). Typically 5-10 Mpc/h for LRGs.

Shifted galaxy + random catalogs after reconstruction, QSO parent sample
(z=0.8-2.1). Same NPZ format as post_recon_catalog_lrg_full. QSO uses
Sigma_sm = 30 h^-1 Mpc rather than 15 h^-1 Mpc.
Mean |Psi| for QSO parent (Mpc/h).

Shifted galaxy + random catalogs after reconstruction, ELG parent sample
(z=0.8-1.6). Same format as post_recon_catalog_lrg_full. Sliced
downstream into ELG1 (0.8-1.1) and (later) ELG2 (1.1-1.6).
Mean |Psi| for ELG parent (Mpc/h).

decisions.label: Reconstruction algorithm
decisions.rationale:
Fiducial choice is IterativeFFT. MultiGrid is the main
alternative; results are consistent (HOD-level).

decisions.label: Reconstruction convention
decisions.rationale:
RecSym shifts both data and randoms by the redshift-space displacement
(fiducial -- physically motivated, simpler BAO damping).
RecIso is the legacy convention (data shifted by full
displacement, randoms by real-space-only).

decisions.label: Reconstruction Gaussian smoothing scale (BGS/LRG/ELG)
decisions.rationale:
Smoothing scale Sigma_sm applied to the density field before solving
for the displacement, for the BGS / LRG / ELG parents.
The BAO model's damping correction uses the same value, so recon and
fit must agree -- that's why this lives at the root and recon inherits
it. QSO has a distinct fiducial (sm30 vs sm15 here) and is
parameterized separately via `smoothing_radius_qso`.

decisions.label: Reconstruction Gaussian smoothing scale (QSO only)
decisions.rationale:
QSO's fiducial reconstruction smoothing is 30 h⁻¹ Mpc (vs 15 h⁻¹ Mpc
for BGS/LRG/ELG), reflecting the QSO sample's lower number density
and larger coherence scale. The BAO model's damping template must
match, so both the recon script and the fit scripts branch on
`tracer.id == "qso"` to consume this decision rather than
`smoothing_radius`. sm20 is the sensitivity-test alternative for QSO.

decisions.label: Linear bias used in reconstruction
decisions.rationale:
Reconstruction needs a galaxy bias to convert observed density into a
matter displacement. Fiducial is a fixed value per parent sample;
alternatively we can estimate b from the large-scale clustering of the
data itself.

options.label: Estimated from data
options.description: Fit b from the pre-recon P(k) at k < BIAS_KMAX.

decisions.label: Number of reconstruction iterations
decisions.rationale:
IterativeFFT iterates the displacement solve. 3 is the standard choice;
results are robust beyond ~3 iterations.

decisions.label: Imaging-systematics weights
decisions.rationale:
BAO is insensitive to the imaging-systematics correction (largest
shift 0.27 sigma across tracers). This decision exposes that null
test. `on` uses the full DESI `WEIGHT` column
(WEIGHT_COMP * WEIGHT_SYS * WEIGHT_ZFAIL). `off` drops the WEIGHT_SYS
factor, keeping only completeness + redshift-failure corrections.
